items.question: Trong câu "An IP address identifies which computer you're talking to.", từ "identify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An IP address identifies which computer you're talking to.", what does "identify" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to show which one it is
items.explanation: identify /aɪˈden.tɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): xác định, nhận diện. "Identify which X" = xác định X nào; nghĩa khác: identify with (đồng cảm với).
items.explanationEn: identify /aɪˈden.tɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to show which one it is. "Identify which X" means tell exactly which one; another sense is identify with (feel close to).

items.question: Trong câu "But a single computer can run many network applications at the same time (web browser, email, games, etc.).", từ "single" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But a single computer can run many network applications at the same time (web browser, email, games, etc.).", what does "single" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: single /ˈsɪŋ.ɡəl/ (tính từ): chỉ một. "A single computer" = chỉ một máy tính; nghĩa khác: độc thân.
items.explanationEn: single /ˈsɪŋ.ɡəl/ (adjective): just one. "A single computer" means only one; another sense is unmarried.

items.question: Trong câu "But a single computer can run many network applications at the same time (web browser, email, games, etc.).", từ "at the same time" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "But a single computer can run many network applications at the same time (web browser, email, games, etc.).", what does "at the same time" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at the same time /ət ðə ˌseɪm ˈtaɪm/ (cụm từ): cùng một lúc. "At the same time" = đồng thời; còn dùng để nối ý "tuy nhiên" (at the same time, ...).
items.explanationEn: at the same time /ət ðə ˌseɪm ˈtaɪm/ (phrase): simultaneously. "At the same time" means simultaneously; it can also mean "however" when linking ideas.

items.question: Trong câu "A port helps distinguish which application receives which data.", từ "distinguish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A port helps distinguish which application receives which data.", what does "distinguish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: distinguish /dɪˈstɪŋ.ɡwɪʃ/ (động từ): phân biệt. "Distinguish A from B" = phân biệt A với B; đừng nhầm với extinguish (dập tắt).
items.explanationEn: distinguish /dɪˈstɪŋ.ɡwɪʃ/ (verb): to tell apart. "Distinguish A from B" means tell them apart; do not confuse it with extinguish.

items.question: Trong câu "A port helps distinguish which application receives which data.", từ "port" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A port helps distinguish which application receives which data.", what does "port" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the left side of a ship
items.explanation: port /pɔːt/ (danh từ): cổng mạng (số hiệu). "Port" trong mạng là số hiệu phân biệt ứng dụng; nghĩa khác: cảng biển, cổng cắm (USB port).
items.explanationEn: port /pɔːt/ (noun): a numbered network endpoint. In networking a port is a number that tells apps apart; other senses: a harbour, a plug slot (USB port).

items.question: Trong câu "You arrive at the building → you only meet the right person by entering the right room.", từ "arrive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You arrive at the building → you only meet the right person by entering the right room.", what does "arrive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: arrive /əˈraɪv/ (động từ): đến nơi. "Arrive at + địa điểm nhỏ" (building), "arrive in + thành phố/quốc gia".
items.explanationEn: arrive /əˈraɪv/ (verb): to reach a place. "Arrive at" is used for a building or spot; "arrive in" for a city or country.

items.question: Trong câu "You arrive at the building → you only meet the right person by entering the right room.", từ "enter" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You arrive at the building → you only meet the right person by entering the right room.", what does "enter" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to sign up for a contest
items.explanation: enter /ˈen.tər/ (động từ): đi vào. "Enter a room" = đi vào phòng (không dùng "enter into"); nghĩa khác: nhập (enter a password).
items.explanationEn: enter /ˈen.tər/ (verb): to go into. "Enter a room" means go into it (no "into" needed); another sense is type in (enter a password).

items.question: Trong câu "A port is an integer from 0 to 65535.", từ "integer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A port is an integer from 0 to 65535.", what does "integer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: integer /ˈɪn.tɪ.dʒər/ (danh từ): số nguyên. "Integer" = số nguyên (không có phần thập phân); trong lập trình: kiểu int.
items.explanationEn: integer /ˈɪn.tɪ.dʒər/ (noun): a whole number. An integer is a whole number with no fractional part; in code, the int type.

items.question: Trong câu "Reserved for standard services", từ "reserve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reserved for standard services", what does "reserve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reserve /rɪˈzɜːv/ (động từ): dành riêng (cho mục đích). "Reserved for X" = dành riêng cho X; nghĩa khác: đặt trước (reserve a table).
items.explanationEn: reserve /rɪˈzɜːv/ (verb): to keep for a purpose. "Reserved for X" means kept only for X; another sense is to book (reserve a table).

items.question: Trong câu "Reserved for standard services", từ "standard" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reserved for standard services", what does "standard" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: standard /ˈstæn.dəd/ (tính từ): tiêu chuẩn, phổ biến chung. "Standard services" = dịch vụ tiêu chuẩn như HTTP, SSH; danh từ: a standard (tiêu chuẩn).
items.explanationEn: standard /ˈstæn.dəd/ (adjective): widely accepted as normal. "Standard services" are common agreed ones like HTTP or SSH; noun: a standard.

items.question: Trong câu "Registered by specific applications", từ "specific" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Registered by specific applications", what does "specific" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: specific /spəˈsɪf.ɪk/ (tính từ): cụ thể, nhất định. "Specific applications" = các ứng dụng cụ thể; trạng từ: specifically.
items.explanationEn: specific /spəˈsɪf.ɪk/ (adjective): particular. "Specific applications" are particular ones; adverb: specifically.

items.question: Trong câu "Used temporarily by clients", từ "temporarily" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Used temporarily by clients", what does "temporarily" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: temporarily /ˈtem.pər.er.əl.i/ (trạng từ): tạm thời. "Used temporarily" = dùng tạm thời rồi trả lại; tính từ: temporary; trái nghĩa: permanently.
items.explanationEn: temporarily /ˈtem.pər.er.əl.i/ (adverb): for a short time. "Used temporarily" means used for a while then released; adjective: temporary; opposite: permanently.

items.question: Trong câu "A port helps distinguish which application receives which data.", từ "application" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A port helps distinguish which application receives which data.", what does "application" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: application /ˌæp.lɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): ứng dụng (phần mềm). "Application" = ứng dụng (viết tắt app); nghĩa khác: đơn xin (job application).
items.explanationEn: application /ˌæp.lɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a computer program. An application is a program (app for short); another sense is a formal request (job application).

items.question: Trong câu "A port helps distinguish which application receives which data.", từ "receive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A port helps distinguish which application receives which data.", what does "receive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: receive /rɪˈsiːv/ (động từ): nhận. "Receive data" = nhận dữ liệu; trái nghĩa: send; danh từ: receiver.
items.explanationEn: receive /rɪˈsiːv/ (verb): to be given. "Receive data" means get data that was sent; opposite: send; noun: receiver.

items.question: Trong câu "Convention for Node.js dev", từ "convention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Convention for Node.js dev", what does "convention" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: convention /kənˈven.ʃən/ (danh từ): quy ước. "Convention" = quy ước chung (port 3000 cho Node.js); nghĩa khác: hội nghị; tính từ: conventional.
items.explanationEn: convention /kənˈven.ʃən/ (noun): a usual agreed practice. A convention is an agreed habit (port 3000 for Node.js); another sense is a conference; adjective: conventional.

items.question: Trong câu "Alternative to port 80 during dev", từ "alternative" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Alternative to port 80 during dev", what does "alternative" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: alternative /ɔːlˈtɜː.nə.tɪv/ (danh từ): lựa chọn thay thế. "An alternative to X" = phương án thay thế cho X; trạng từ: alternatively.
items.explanationEn: alternative /ɔːlˈtɜː.nə.tɪv/ (noun): another possible choice. "An alternative to X" is another option instead of X; adverb: alternatively.

items.question: Trong câu "A firewall controls network traffic by opening or blocking ports:", từ "firewall" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A firewall controls network traffic by opening or blocking ports:", what does "firewall" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: firewall /ˈfaɪə.wɔːl/ (danh từ): tường lửa (lọc truy cập mạng). "Firewall" trong IT = tường lửa chặn/cho phép lưu lượng; nghĩa gốc: tường ngăn cháy trong tòa nhà.
items.explanationEn: firewall /ˈfaɪə.wɔːl/ (noun): a system filtering network traffic. In IT a firewall filters traffic; the literal sense is a wall that stops fire spreading in a building.

items.question: Trong câu "Remote server control", từ "remote" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Remote server control", what does "remote" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: remote /rɪˈməʊt/ (tính từ): từ xa. "Remote control" = điều khiển từ xa; nghĩa khác: hẻo lánh (a remote village), rất nhỏ (a remote chance).
items.explanationEn: remote /rɪˈməʊt/ (adjective): from a distance. "Remote control" means operating from a distance; other senses: isolated (a remote village), slight (a remote chance).

items.question: Trong câu "A firewall controls network traffic by opening or blocking ports:", từ "traffic" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A firewall controls network traffic by opening or blocking ports:", what does "traffic" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: traffic /ˈtræf.ɪk/ (danh từ): lưu lượng truy cập (dữ liệu). "Network traffic" = lưu lượng mạng; nghĩa khác: giao thông, buôn lậu (drug trafficking).
items.explanationEn: traffic /ˈtræf.ɪk/ (noun): data moving over a network. "Network traffic" is data flowing through a network; other senses: road traffic, illegal trade.

items.question: Trong câu "A firewall controls network traffic by opening or blocking ports:", từ "block" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A firewall controls network traffic by opening or blocking ports:", what does "block" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: block /blɒk/ (động từ): chặn. "Block a port" = chặn cổng; danh từ "block" = khối, dãy nhà.
items.explanationEn: block /blɒk/ (verb): to stop from passing. "Block a port" means stop traffic through it; as a noun, a block is a chunk or a city block.

items.question: Trong câu "Open only ports 80 and 443 → the server only serves web traffic.", từ "serve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Open only ports 80 and 443 → the server only serves web traffic.", what does "serve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: serve /sɜːv/ (động từ): phục vụ, xử lý (yêu cầu). "Serve web traffic" = phục vụ các yêu cầu web; nghĩa khác: dọn món, giao bóng; danh từ: server.
items.explanationEn: serve /sɜːv/ (verb): to handle requests for. "Serve web traffic" means respond to web requests; other senses: bring food, start a tennis point; noun: server.

items.question: Trong câu "When deploying an application on the cloud (AWS, GCP, etc.), you must configure Security Group / Firewall rules to open the right ports.", từ "deploy" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When deploying an application on the cloud (AWS, GCP, etc.), you must configure Security Group / Firewall rules to open the right ports.", what does "deploy" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: deploy /dɪˈplɔɪ/ (động từ): triển khai (lên môi trường thật). "Deploy an application" = triển khai ứng dụng; danh từ: deployment.
items.explanationEn: deploy /dɪˈplɔɪ/ (verb): to put into real use. "Deploy an application" means release it to run for real; noun: deployment.

items.question: Trong câu "When deploying an application on the cloud (AWS, GCP, etc.), you must configure Security Group / Firewall rules to open the right ports.", từ "cloud" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When deploying an application on the cloud (AWS, GCP, etc.), you must configure Security Group / Firewall rules to open the right ports.", what does "cloud" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: cloud /klaʊd/ (danh từ): điện toán đám mây. "On the cloud" = trên đám mây (máy chủ thuê qua Internet); nghĩa gốc: đám mây trên trời.
items.explanationEn: cloud /klaʊd/ (noun): online computing services. "On the cloud" means on rented servers over the Internet; the literal sense is a cloud in the sky.

items.question: Trong câu "When deploying an application on the cloud (AWS, GCP, etc.), you must configure Security Group / Firewall rules to open the right ports.", từ "configure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When deploying an application on the cloud (AWS, GCP, etc.), you must configure Security Group / Firewall rules to open the right ports.", what does "configure" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: configure /kənˈfɪɡ.ər/ (động từ): cấu hình, thiết lập. "Configure rules" = cấu hình quy tắc; danh từ: configuration (thường viết tắt config).
items.explanationEn: configure /kənˈfɪɡ.ər/ (verb): to set up settings. "Configure rules" means set them up; noun: configuration, often shortened to config.

items.question: Trong câu "When deploying an application on the cloud (AWS, GCP, etc.), you must configure Security Group / Firewall rules to open the right ports.", từ "rule" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When deploying an application on the cloud (AWS, GCP, etc.), you must configure Security Group / Firewall rules to open the right ports.", what does "rule" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a setting that allows or denies
items.explanation: rule /ruːl/ (danh từ): quy tắc (cho phép/chặn). "Firewall rules" = các quy tắc tường lửa; nghĩa khác: sự cai trị (under British rule).
items.explanationEn: rule /ruːl/ (noun): a setting that allows or denies. "Firewall rules" are settings that allow or deny traffic; another sense is governing (under British rule).

items.question: Trong câu "A socket is the endpoint of a network connection — a combination of:", từ "socket" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A socket is the endpoint of a network connection — a combination of:", what does "socket" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: socket /ˈsɒk.ɪt/ (danh từ): điểm cuối kết nối mạng. "Socket" trong mạng = IP + port + giao thức; nghĩa gốc: ổ cắm điện, hốc (eye socket).
items.explanationEn: socket /ˈsɒk.ɪt/ (noun): a network connection endpoint. In networking a socket is IP + port + protocol; literal senses: a power outlet, a hollow (eye socket).

items.question: Trong câu "A socket is the endpoint of a network connection — a combination of:", từ "endpoint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A socket is the endpoint of a network connection — a combination of:", what does "endpoint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: endpoint /ˈend.pɔɪnt/ (danh từ): điểm cuối. "Endpoint" = điểm cuối của kết nối; trong API: endpoint là URL nhận request.
items.explanationEn: endpoint /ˈend.pɔɪnt/ (noun): the point at either end. An endpoint is one end of a connection; in APIs, an endpoint is a URL that takes requests.

items.question: Trong câu "When you connect to a server, the OS creates a pair of sockets:", từ "pair" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you connect to a server, the OS creates a pair of sockets:", what does "pair" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pair /peər/ (danh từ): một cặp. "A pair of X" = một cặp X; hay gặp: pair programming (lập trình theo cặp).
items.explanationEn: pair /peər/ (noun): a set of two. "A pair of X" means two X; see also pair programming.

items.question: Trong câu "Client socket: client_IP:54321 (random port)", từ "random" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Client socket: client_IP:54321 (random port)", what does "random" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: random /ˈræn.dəm/ (tính từ): ngẫu nhiên. "Random port" = port chọn ngẫu nhiên; nghĩa lóng: vớ vẩn, lạ (that's so random).
items.explanationEn: random /ˈræn.dəm/ (adjective): chosen by chance. "Random port" is picked by chance; in slang, random means odd or unexpected.

items.question: Trong câu "A WebSocket is a protocol that allows a two-way, persistent connection between client and server — unlike HTTP, which communicates only in a one-way request-response manner.", từ "protocol" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A WebSocket is a protocol that allows a two-way, persistent connection between client and server — unlike HTTP, which communicates only in a one-way request-response manner.", what does "protocol" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: protocol /ˈprəʊ.tə.kɒl/ (danh từ): giao thức. "WebSocket is a protocol" = WebSocket là một giao thức truyền thông; nghĩa khác: nghi thức.
items.explanationEn: protocol /ˈprəʊ.tə.kɒl/ (noun): a set of communication rules. "WebSocket is a protocol" means a set of communication rules; another sense is formal etiquette.

items.question: Trong câu "A WebSocket is a protocol that allows a two-way, persistent connection between client and server — unlike HTTP, which communicates only in a one-way request-response manner.", từ "allow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A WebSocket is a protocol that allows a two-way, persistent connection between client and server — unlike HTTP, which communicates only in a one-way request-response manner.", what does "allow" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allow /əˈlaʊ/ (động từ): cho phép, giúp có thể. "Allow X" = cho phép/tạo điều kiện cho X; "allow sb to do sth".
items.explanationEn: allow /əˈlaʊ/ (verb): to make possible. "Allow X" means make X possible; pattern: allow someone to do something.

items.question: Trong câu "A WebSocket is a protocol that allows a two-way, persistent connection between client and server — unlike HTTP, which communicates only in a one-way request-response manner.", từ "two-way" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A WebSocket is a protocol that allows a two-way, persistent connection between client and server — unlike HTTP, which communicates only in a one-way request-response manner.", what does "two-way" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: two-way /ˌtuːˈweɪ/ (tính từ): hai chiều. "Two-way connection" = kết nối hai chiều; trái nghĩa: one-way.
items.explanationEn: two-way /ˌtuːˈweɪ/ (adjective): in both directions. "Two-way connection" lets data flow both ways; the opposite is one-way.

items.question: Trong câu "A WebSocket is a protocol that allows a two-way, persistent connection between client and server — unlike HTTP, which communicates only in a one-way request-response manner.", từ "unlike" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A WebSocket is a protocol that allows a two-way, persistent connection between client and server — unlike HTTP, which communicates only in a one-way request-response manner.", what does "unlike" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: unlike /ʌnˈlaɪk/ (giới từ): không giống như, khác với. "Unlike X, ..." = khác với X; dùng để so sánh đối lập.
items.explanationEn: unlike /ʌnˈlaɪk/ (preposition): different from. "Unlike X, ..." introduces a contrast with X.

items.question: Trong câu "A WebSocket is a protocol that allows a two-way, persistent connection between client and server — unlike HTTP, which communicates only in a one-way request-response manner.", từ "communicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A WebSocket is a protocol that allows a two-way, persistent connection between client and server — unlike HTTP, which communicates only in a one-way request-response manner.", what does "communicate" (verb) mean?
options: giao tiếp, trao đổi dữ liệu
items.explanation: communicate /kəˈmjuː.nɪ.keɪt/ (động từ): giao tiếp, trao đổi dữ liệu. "Communicate" = trao đổi thông tin; danh từ: communication; nghĩa khác: lây (communicable disease).
items.explanationEn: communicate /kəˈmjuː.nɪ.keɪt/ (verb): to exchange information. "Communicate" means exchange information; noun: communication; another sense is spreading disease.

items.question: Trong câu "A WebSocket is a protocol that allows a two-way, persistent connection between client and server — unlike HTTP, which communicates only in a one-way request-response manner.", từ "manner" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A WebSocket is a protocol that allows a two-way, persistent connection between client and server — unlike HTTP, which communicates only in a one-way request-response manner.", what does "manner" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: manner /ˈmæn.ər/ (danh từ): cách thức. "In a ... manner" = theo cách...; "manners" (số nhiều) = phép lịch sự; đừng nhầm với manor.
items.explanationEn: manner /ˈmæn.ər/ (noun): a way of doing. "In a ... manner" means in a certain way; plural "manners" means politeness; do not confuse with manor.

items.question: Trong câu "Used for: chat apps, real-time notifications, online games, live dashboards.", từ "notification" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Used for: chat apps, real-time notifications, online games, live dashboards.", what does "notification" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: notification /ˌnəʊ.tɪ.fɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): thông báo. "Real-time notifications" = thông báo tức thời; động từ: notify.
items.explanationEn: notification /ˌnəʊ.tɪ.fɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): an alert message. "Real-time notifications" are instant alerts; verb: notify.

items.question: Trong câu "Used for: chat apps, real-time notifications, online games, live dashboards.", từ "real-time" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Used for: chat apps, real-time notifications, online games, live dashboards.", what does "real-time" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: real-time /ˌrɪəl ˈtaɪm/ (tính từ): thời gian thực, tức thời. "Real-time" = thời gian thực, gần như không có độ trễ; hay gặp: real-time chat.
items.explanationEn: real-time /ˌrɪəl ˈtaɪm/ (adjective): happening instantly. "Real-time" means with almost no delay; see real-time chat.

items.question: Trong câu "A socket is the endpoint of a network connection — a combination of:", từ "connection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A socket is the endpoint of a network connection — a combination of:", what does "connection" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: connection /kəˈnek.ʃən/ (danh từ): kết nối (mạng). "Network connection" = kết nối mạng; nghĩa khác: quan hệ quen biết (have connections).
items.explanationEn: connection /kəˈnek.ʃən/ (noun): a network link. "Network connection" is a link between machines; another sense is people you know (have connections).

items.question: Trong câu "When you connect to a server, the OS creates a pair of sockets:", từ "create" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you connect to a server, the OS creates a pair of sockets:", what does "create" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: create /kriˈeɪt/ (động từ): tạo ra. "Create a socket" = tạo socket; danh từ: creation; tính từ: creative (sáng tạo).
items.explanationEn: create /kriˈeɪt/ (verb): to make. "Create a socket" means make one; noun: creation; adjective: creative.

items.question: Trong câu "A WebSocket is a protocol that allows a two-way, persistent connection between client and server — unlike HTTP, which communicates only in a one-way request-response manner.", từ "one-way" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A WebSocket is a protocol that allows a two-way, persistent connection between client and server — unlike HTTP, which communicates only in a one-way request-response manner.", what does "one-way" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: one-way /ˌwʌnˈweɪ/ (tính từ): một chiều. "One-way" = một chiều (như đường một chiều: one-way street); trái nghĩa: two-way.
items.explanationEn: one-way /ˌwʌnˈweɪ/ (adjective): in one direction only. "One-way" means flowing one direction, like a one-way street; opposite: two-way.

items.question: Trong câu "When you don't type a port in the URL, the browser uses the default port:", từ "type" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you don't type a port in the URL, the browser uses the default port:", what does "type" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: type /taɪp/ (động từ): gõ (bằng bàn phím). "Type a port" = gõ số port; danh từ "type" = loại, kiểu.
items.explanationEn: type /taɪp/ (verb): to write with a keyboard. "Type a port" means enter it with the keyboard; as a noun, type means kind.

items.question: Trong câu "When you don't type a port in the URL, the browser uses the default port:", từ "port" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you don't type a port in the URL, the browser uses the default port:", what does "port" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: port /pɔːt/ (danh từ): cổng (số hiệu dịch vụ). "The default port" = cổng mặc định (80 cho HTTP, 443 cho HTTPS); nghĩa khác: bến cảng.
items.explanationEn: port /pɔːt/ (noun): a numbered service endpoint. "The default port" is 80 for HTTP and 443 for HTTPS; another sense is a harbour.

items.question: Trong câu "When you don't type a port in the URL, the browser uses the default port:", từ "browser" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you don't type a port in the URL, the browser uses the default port:", what does "browser" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: browser /ˈbraʊ.zər/ (danh từ): trình duyệt web. "Browser" = trình duyệt; động từ "browse" = lướt xem; đừng nhầm với search engine.
items.explanationEn: browser /ˈbraʊ.zər/ (noun): an app for viewing websites. A browser is an app for viewing websites; verb: browse; do not confuse it with a search engine.

items.question: Trong câu "When you don't type a port in the URL, the browser uses the default port:", từ "default" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you don't type a port in the URL, the browser uses the default port:", what does "default" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (tính từ): mặc định. "Default port" = cổng mặc định; "by default" = theo mặc định.
items.explanationEn: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (adjective): used unless changed. "Default port" is the one used unless you specify another; "by default".

items.question: Trong câu "When developing locally: http://localhost:3000 — you must type the port explicitly because there's no default.", từ "develop" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When developing locally: http://localhost:3000 — you must type the port explicitly because there's no default.", what does "develop" (verb) mean?
options: phát triển phần mềm, lập trình
items.explanation: develop /dɪˈvel.əp/ (động từ): phát triển phần mềm, lập trình. "Developing locally" = lập trình trên máy mình; nghĩa khác: rửa ảnh, phát bệnh (develop a disease).
items.explanationEn: develop /dɪˈvel.əp/ (verb): to build software. "Developing locally" means building software on your own machine; other senses: process film, catch a disease.

items.question: Trong câu "When developing locally: http://localhost:3000 — you must type the port explicitly because there's no default.", từ "locally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When developing locally: http://localhost:3000 — you must type the port explicitly because there's no default.", what does "locally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: locally /ˈləʊ.kəl.i/ (trạng từ): trên máy cục bộ. "Run locally" = chạy trên máy của bạn; nghĩa đời thường: ở địa phương; trái nghĩa: remotely.
items.explanationEn: locally /ˈləʊ.kəl.i/ (adverb): on your own machine. "Run locally" means on your own computer; everyday sense: in the local area; opposite: remotely.

items.question: Trong câu "When developing locally: http://localhost:3000 — you must type the port explicitly because there's no default.", từ "explicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When developing locally: http://localhost:3000 — you must type the port explicitly because there's no default.", what does "explicitly" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách rõ ràng, tường minh
items.explanation: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách rõ ràng, tường minh. "Type the port explicitly" = ghi rõ port ra; trái nghĩa: implicitly (ngầm định).
items.explanationEn: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt.li/ (adverb): clearly and directly. "Type the port explicitly" means state it clearly; the opposite is implicitly.

items.question: Trong câu "When developing locally: http://localhost:3000 — you must type the port explicitly because there's no default.", từ "localhost" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When developing locally: http://localhost:3000 — you must type the port explicitly because there's no default.", what does "localhost" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: localhost /ˈləʊ.kəl.həʊst/ (danh từ): chính máy tính của bạn. "Localhost" = local (cục bộ) + host (máy); luôn trỏ về chính máy đang dùng.
items.explanationEn: localhost /ˈləʊ.kəl.həʊst/ (noun): your own computer. "Localhost" is local + host; it always refers to the machine you are using.

items.question: Trong câu "Port 22: SSH (server management).", từ "management" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Port 22: SSH (server management).", what does "management" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: management /ˈmæn.ɪdʒ.mənt/ (danh từ): sự quản lý, quản trị. "Server management" = quản trị máy chủ; nghĩa khác: ban lãnh đạo (the management).
items.explanationEn: management /ˈmæn.ɪdʒ.mənt/ (noun): the act of running something. "Server management" means running and administering servers; "the management" can also mean the bosses.

items.question: Trong câu "Socket: the combination of IP + Port + Protocol forming a connection endpoint.", từ "combination" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Socket: the combination of IP + Port + Protocol forming a connection endpoint.", what does "combination" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: combination /ˌkɒm.bɪˈneɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự kết hợp. "The combination of A + B + C" = sự kết hợp của A, B, C; động từ: combine.
items.explanationEn: combination /ˌkɒm.bɪˈneɪ.ʃən/ (noun): things joined together. "The combination of A + B + C" means them joined together; verb: combine.

items.question: Trong câu "Socket: the combination of IP + Port + Protocol forming a connection endpoint.", từ "form" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Socket: the combination of IP + Port + Protocol forming a connection endpoint.", what does "form" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: form /fɔːm/ (động từ): tạo thành. "Forming an endpoint" = tạo thành một điểm cuối; danh từ "form" = biểu mẫu, hình dạng.
items.explanationEn: form /fɔːm/ (verb): to make up. "Forming an endpoint" means making one up; as a noun, a form is a document or a shape.

items.question: Trong câu "WebSocket: a persistent two-way connection for real-time apps.", từ "persistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "WebSocket: a persistent two-way connection for real-time apps.", what does "persistent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: persistent /pəˈsɪs.tənt/ (tính từ): duy trì liên tục. "Persistent connection" = kết nối được giữ mở liên tục; nghĩa khác: kiên trì (a persistent person).
items.explanationEn: persistent /pəˈsɪs.tənt/ (adjective): lasting without closing. "Persistent connection" stays open; another sense is determined (a persistent person).
